title: The Hermitian inner product selects the time axis, the Born rule measures it
summary: The correspondence between $2\times 2$ Hermitian matrices and Minkowski $4$-vectors recovers Lorentzian symmetries from the internal degrees of freedom of a qubit, with no reference to an external spacetime. Recent work characterises the resulting Lorentz invariants and leaves the \emph{mechanism} of emergence -- what singles out a time direction -- as an explicit open question. We give an elementary answer and, in doing so, correct a natural misattribution.
